items.large_file_assessment: The final 102-page report is 25,114,690 bytes (23.95 MiB), crossing the project's 25-million-byte warning point but remaining well below 100 MB. Its graphics, tables, appendices, and full existing-conditions analysis explain the size. A slightly smaller draft exists, but no smaller authoritative final version was located; optimization would alter the source, so the original final report is preserved unchanged.
